https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP4399-PPSA26575_00-PROJECTMOTORRACE

Experience the thrills and speed of endurance racing in Project Motor Racing. The World Endurance Pack delivers a blend of old and new with 11 cars across 4 endurance classes and the iconic Fuji Speedway circuit in a modern and a historic version featuring a total of 6 layouts.  

The LMP1 class brings back the start of the 2010’s hybrid era with the 2016 Audi R18, Porsche 919 Hybrid and the Toyota TS050 Hybrid. While LMP2 and LMP2 EVO introduce two new classes paying homage to two eras of prototype racing with the 2013 Olivera P2-13 and the 2026 Olivera P2-26 EVO respectively. Then GTP turns back the clocks by bringing six cars from the iconic US racing series with the 1986 BMW March GTP, 1986 Chevrolet Corvette C4 GTP, 1986 Ford Probe GTP, 1988 Jaguar XJR 9 GTP, 1988 Nissan GTP SX-Turbo and the 1988 Porsche 962 GTP.
